name: Ferienhotel Lenzenhof
beschreibung:
Set amidst the scenic mountain landscapes of the Wildschoenau, the traditional Ferienhotel Lenzenhof welcomes travellers with authentic Tyrolean warmth. Comfortable rooms provide a cosy retreat with pleasing views over the Kitzbuehel Alps.

The Ski Juwel Alpbachtal Wildschoenau winter resort and extensive summer hiking or biking routes promise diverse alpine adventures year-round.
kurzbeschreibung: Ferienhotel Lenzenhof in the Wildschoenau offers rustic alpine charm and peaceful relaxation in one of Tyrol's most pristine high valleys.
